review: RPC FundTransaction accepts explicit changeAddress/changePosition, feeRate in BCH/kB, includeWatching, include_unsafe, lockUnspents and subtractFeeFromOutputs.
Wallet FundTransaction calls CreateTransaction with signing disabled. It retains the caller transaction header and appends wallet-selected inputs plus change.
CreateTransaction uses an explicit change destination when supplied; the new-key reservation path is the alternative branch. KeepKey only acts on an existing reserved key.
New wallet-selected inputs use sequence UINT32_MAX - 1. The Monzero FundingPreview verifier requires Sequence::MAX, so the RPC result is not directly compatible.
Wallet locks are conditional on lockUnspents. Preparation must keep this false; existing admitted-execution locking and sign-only approval remain separate operations.

AvailableCoins excludes immature coinbase, conflicted, spent and locked outputs, and filters unsafe transactions when requested. Token outputs require m_allow_tokens; CCoinControl::SetNull initializes that flag false.

Coin selection can still use the wallet own zero-confirmation change when m_spend_zero_conf_change is enabled, even with include_unsafe false. That flag is not the application minimum-confirmation policy.
FundTransaction enables fAllowOtherInputs, so a supplied input set is not an exact selection constraint. Any adapter relying on selected inputs must check the returned set explicitly.
implementation_gates: Before adding wallet preparation, decide and test explicit unsigned sequence handling without weakening the existing FundingPreview verifier.

Require exact original contract principal, pinned wallet-owned change, canonical unsigned transaction and full parent bytes; independently validate fees, token exclusion, wallet ownership and live spendability.
Do not infer maturity or confirmation policy from wallet selection; apply existing fresh input observations before retaining/locking/signing.
Test unavailable parent transactions, unexpected additional/zero-confirmation inputs, partial retained preparation and changed replies before exposing preparation through helper/Qt.
scope: Source review only. No preparation adapter is implemented by this record; no node was launched and no consensus acceptance is claimed.
